_description: Final track and window selection result from lib/audio/select-music-window.ts.

selected_track.description: track_id of winning track (filename without extension)

selected_track_path.description: Absolute path at time of analysis. Runtime may differ.

reason_selected.description: Measured and inferred reasons the winner was chosen. Each reason references a scored feature.

reason_rejected.description: Per-track rejection reasons. Key = track_id. Values = measured score comparisons.

manual_review_flags.description: Items requiring human review before locking the selection. Empty = safe to proceed without review.

agreement_explanation.note: If system_agrees=false, HUMAN REVIEW REQUIRED is included in the explanation. The disagreement is based on measured scores, not Claude's subjective opinion.

selection_invariants.deterministic: Given the same input files and reel spec, selection is deterministic. Two runs with identical inputs produce identical output.
selection_invariants.auditable: All score components are stored in the analysis files. The selection can be reproduced from the analysis files alone.
selection_invariants.no_subjective_selector: Claude may annotate or explain the selection result but does not determine the winner. The scoring function is the selector.
selection_invariants.human_override: Human may override the system selection. If overriding, document the reason and update mix_plan.json accordingly.
